rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, not_declared, succeeded, not_declared, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, failed. Run 5 declared entry fails importing app from sprat.app, while runs 1-4 declared entries reach a listening HTTP service. Later run-5 scenario requests succeed through a different service entry, so the failure concerns its declared startup entry.
limitation: Undeclared build commands are not counted as successful builds. HTTP listening establishes startup only, not feature fulfillment.
